item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Beach Background for My Portrait

turns.text: Swap the park behind me for a sunny beach with sand and blue sea. Keep my face, hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing the same. Still square, please.

item.tests: Tests beach background replacement while preserving portrait identity, framing and fine hair edges.

answer_sheet.Beach setting: A photorealistic sunny beach with visible sand and blue sea; the location is your call.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: My face, curly hair, sweater, pose and head-and-shoulders framing.
answer_sheet.Size and added text: One square image at the standard free size. No added text.

must_haves: The woman remains recognizably the same person, with the same expression and pose.
Her curly hair and sweater are preserved with clean, natural-looking edges.
Sand and blue sea replace the park background.
The portrait remains head-and-shoulders rather than inventing a full body.
The square image looks like a coherent photograph, not a visibly pasted cutout.

turns.text: Could you edit this pic of me so the park behind me is replaced with a sunny beach? I just feel like a beach background would make this photo feel a little more cheerful. I want sand and blue sea in the background, and it should still be square, please. Keep my face, hair and sweater exactly the same as they are in this pic. Please keep the same head-and-shoulders framing too.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so no image was created.

Once credits are available, I can retry the sunny beach background with sand and blue sea, preserving the square head-and-shoulders framing and keeping your face, hair, and sweater unchanged.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit ONLY the background of this square head-and-shoulders portrait. Replace the park, trees, grass and path behind the woman with a cheerful photorealistic sunny beach: golden sand, clear blue sea, a distant natural horizon and bright blue sky. Keep the background slightly softly focused like a natural portrait. Preserve the woman exactly as in the source: identical facial identity, expression, skin texture, facial features, dark curly hair including all strands and silhouette, gray knitted sweater including texture, neckline and shape, posture and position. Do not retouch, beautify, restyle or relight the person. Preserve the exact same head-and-shoulders framing, subject size, camera angle and square composition. No added accessories, people, text or foreground objects. Clean natural edges around the original hair and sweater.
